propositions: CodeQL reports two high-severity py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts at lines 249 and 250 in test_llm_fallback_chain.py where URL host validation uses startswith on base_url strings instead of comparing parsed URL origins
The startswith prefix check is weakly anchored and would incorrectly accept a malicious host like https://fallback.test.evil.example that shares the endpoint prefix
The test assertion must be strengthened to compare exact URL origins (scheme + netloc tuples) via urllib.parse.urlsplit rather than substring matching
The endpoint constant must be single-sourced to prevent drift between the configured fallback endpoint and the assertion that verifies models use it
After fix, CodeQL re-scan must report zero open py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts and the test must still fail if fallback entry falls back to provider default
